title: Ask MetaFilter Has Reading Opinions (Again)
content:
Hey Scifi readers, how's your To Be Read pile doing? Hope it's on something sturdy, because Frowner's question in AskMetaFilter is about to add a lot to it, so here it is: Your personal best SFF read of 2025 was....

Come for the recommendations, stay for the gentle peer pressure and very strong feelings about space, magic, and feelings in space!
author: Brandon Blatcher
